name: allocation-api

dependencies.name: hr-entity-service
dependencies.description: Searches People App employees when a resource manager adds a consultant, and reads a consultant's employee information live.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the allocation notices to engagement managers and consultants.

dependencies.name: erp-service
dependencies.description: Converts amounts to USD for cost views and receives an engagement's travel expenses when they are submitted.

description: The single backend for engagements, consultants and their cost rates, allocations, cost reports and travel expenses. It owns all records in its Postgres database, computes cost on request from allocations and rates, reads employees from People App, sends allocation notices by email and pushes submitted travel expenses to NetSuite. It is one service because every part shares the same records and deploys together; it holds no screens and does not issue tokens.
